cohort: The study included 71 patients experiencing periviable premature rupture of membranes (PROM) between 15 and 23+6 weeks of gestation.
finding: The neonatal survival rate for periviable PROM between 15 and 23+6 weeks of gestation was 26.8%, with increased survival significantly associated with gestational age at delivery, duration of latency, and antenatal steroid administration.
